review:
The newest Dog House, with bigger wilds: they can land as a normal symbol, a 1x3 expanded wild or a 3x3 colossal one, all carrying 2x or 3x multipliers that combine.

Three paw scatters trigger the bonus – nine mini reels spin first to award up to 27 free spins. Wild multipliers stick through the feature, and ghost wilds up to 3x can land, filling in wins but also removing random sticky wilds before the next spin. 96.53% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
